nodes.summary: A group $G$ satisfies the maximal condition on subgroups when every subgroup of $G$ is finitely generated.
nodes.title: Maximal condition on subgroups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ satisfies the minimal condition on subgroups when the order on subgroups of $G$ by inclusion is well-founded: every nonempty set of subgroups of $G$ has a minimal element, equivalently there is no infinite strictly descending chain of subgroups of $G$.
nodes.title: Minimal condition on subgroups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is a minimax group when it has a finite subnormal series $1 = H_0 \le H_1 \le \dots \le H_n = G$, with each $H_i$ normal in $H_{i+1}$, such that every factor $H_{i+1}/H_i$ satisfies the maximal condition on subgroups or the minimal condition on subgroups.
nodes.title: Minimax groups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is residually finite when for every element $g \ne 1$ of $G$ there is a normal subgroup $N$ of finite index in $G$ with $g \notin N$.
nodes.title: Residually finite groups

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finitely generated soluble minimax group and let $H$ be a finitely generated residually finite group with the same finite images as $G$: a finite group is a homomorphic image of $G$ exactly when it is a homomorphic image of $H$. Then $H$ is a minimax group.
nodes.title: Finite images determine minimaxity (Mann–Segal)

nodes.summary: The statement that for all groups $G$ and $H$, if $G$ is a finitely generated soluble minimax group and $H$ is a finitely generated residually finite group with the same finite images as $G$ (a finite group is a homomorphic image of $G$ exactly when it is a homomorphic image of $H$), then $H$ is a minimax group.
nodes.title: Minimax groups and finite images (Kourovka 12.90)

nodes.summary: Two groups $G$ and $H$ have the same finite images when, for every finite group $Q$, there is a surjective homomorphism $G \to Q$ exactly when there is a surjective homomorphism $H \to Q$.
nodes.title: Groups with the same finite images

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
